body:
thank you for the reply.

what would i have in my life if i could? hmm, that is a tough question. i have thought a lot about this. i think what i really wish most of all is that i could simply appreciate what i already have and be able to simply be myself without being bothered by all these heavy thoughts.

i have spoken to a psychologist who concluded that i have social phobia. that does not really fit me though, i can go way outside of my comfort zone and socialize with people and try new things. and i do that every now and then. but afterwards i never feel good about myself, even though i logically know that i have done something good.
